author: WaveConquerer
body:
Greetings all.  I would like to get back into map making for the fifth or sixth time and would like to ask two specific questions:

1: Can anyone provide me with a link to World Edit for Mac and a little bit of info as to how to install it  (last time I actually had to, it was 1.5 and it installed on its own).  I've tried the internet but I've discovered that anything I found on how to do it was absolute crap in the way of an explanation.

2: Would anyone be able to link me to the 128 by 128 media fire download of the blank pallet by Obsid?  It would save me a lot of time in figuring out how to get a void world.

Thanks for the help, whoever brings it,
WaveConquerer

(Also I apologize if this has been covered somewhere else on the forum.  I was in a bit of a rush writing this so I didn't check.  If it was covered, link me to those threads and lock this one).
